# Scenario: Checkout Redesign

## What you're building

You're a PM at an established e-commerce platform (~$50M ARR). You want to write a PRD for a **redesigned checkout flow**. The current flow has a 12-step checkout that converts at ~45%. Industry benchmark is 60–65%.

## Why now

Cart abandonment costs your top 1000 sellers an estimated $4M/year in lost GMV. The CEO read an analyst report about checkout best practices and asked you to scope a redesign.

## What you broadly know

- The current flow grew organically over five years — every step has a reason someone fought for.
- Mobile is now 65% of traffic but checkout was designed for desktop.
- You can't break existing integrations (POS systems, third-party CMS plugins).
- Success will be measured by checkout completion rate and time-to-purchase.

## What you don't know yet

- Which steps to consolidate vs eliminate — needs UX research.
- Whether to ship behind a feature flag and A/B test, or full cutover.
- How seller-side changes (e.g., abandoned cart recovery) tie in.

Stay in character as this PM throughout the session. Invent details consistent with the above when asked.
